text:
Maya Chen: Quick sync so we can ship the private DP outreach tomorrow. Proposal: cohort=6, staggered starts over 2 weeks, pilot windows 21-45 days based on integration.

Owen Patel: Target mix: 2 regulated (fin/health), 1 ecommerce, 1 mid-market SaaS, 2 wildcards.

Priya Singh: Screener should be 3 Qs: use case + compliance, steady QPS + peak burst, staging access window. Keep it one short form.

Liam Reyes: Instrumentation: replay harness + token sensor + eval CSV. Partners run smoke tests 48h before production flip.

Carol Nguyen: Outreach copy must mention KMS/HSM, data residency, private control plane, what logs we need. I'll draft sub-200 word blurb.

Maya Chen: Success gates per partner: 1) E2E integration validated 2) Perf SLOs (gen p50<80ms p95<300ms @256 tokens; embed p50<30ms p95<80ms) 3) Security checklist cleared 4) Feedback engagement >=6 labeled cases.

Owen Patel: Define labeled case: prompt family + examples + expected behavior + severity + triage ticket. Require 6 families x ~8 examples.

Priya Singh: Incentives: 2 months discounted Dedicated credits + up to 5 eng days + optional co-marketing. Legal wants anonymized metrics consent + light DP addendum.

Liam Reyes: Ops: limited SLA for reserved windows OK if we cap concurrency and document maintenance windows. We'll provide replay repo link at kickoff.

Maya Chen: KPIs to include in outreach: days-to-first-call (<=7 days), eng FTE-days (<=5), feedback items submitted, partner intent to commit.

Carol Nguyen: Action items: @Carol finalize outreach by EOD, @Owen share DP checklist with legal, @Liam prep replay + how-to, @Priya publish eval template. I'll shortlist invites and post Friday.

Legal Bot: Reminder: legal sign-off required before invites go out.
